# 7486 - Quadruple 2-input exclusive-OR element

Package DIP-14 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7486.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7486.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 19 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7486 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7486.png) | ![7486 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/xor2.png) | ![7486 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/xor2.png) |

A rectangle with a vertical line down the centre and a short equals sign (two short horizontal lines) across that line.

How to tell it on a drawing: Mark inside the box = exclusive OR.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

|---|---|---|---|---|

| 2 | 1B | input |  |  |

| 4 | 2A | input |  |  |

| 7 | GND | ground |  |  |
| 8 | 3Y | output | totem-pole |  |

| 13 | 4B | input |  |  |
| 14 | VCC | power |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Y = 1A XOR 1B | 1Y is high when exactly one of 1A, 1B is high. |
| 6 | 2Y = 2A XOR 2B | 2Y is high when exactly one of 2A, 2B is high. |
| 8 | 3Y = 3A XOR 3B | 3Y is high when exactly one of 3A, 3B is high. |
| 11 | 4Y = 4A XOR 4B | 4Y is high when exactly one of 4A, 4B is high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -0.8 |
| inputSchmitt | no |

## Propagation delays

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns | Conditions |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A or B | Y | PLH | 15 | 23 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, other input low |
| A or B | Y | PHL | 11 | 17 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, other input low |
| A or B | Y | PLH | 18 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, other input high |
| A or B | Y | PHL | 13 | 22 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 400 ohm, other input high |

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.
